panels.description: Total CCTVs = count(spacenorm_camera_info) -- every sensor the VisionNode API maps to this deployment, regardless of status. Active CCTVs = count of cameras whose current spacenorm_camera_status is 'connected'. The 'or vector(0)' on the Active query keeps the stat from going blank (rather than showing 0) on the degenerate case where no camera is currently connected at all.

panels.title: CCTV configuration -- all sites, both static and dynamic method
panels.description: Backed by spacenorm_camera_info joined with spacenorm_camera_status on the camera label (PromQL: info * on(camera) group_left(status) status -- group_left(status) copies the status label from the right side onto the joined row; the multiplication's numeric result is always 1 and is excluded from display). Shows every CCTV the VisionNode API maps to this deployment's sensors, not just the ones currently running: a sensor that fails anywhere in the dynamic-config validation pipeline (unresolvable cctv_id, missing private_url, unresolvable vision_node, exhausted RTSP credential probe) still gets a row, red, with the specific cause as its status text, instead of silently being dropped from the table. 'EXCLUDED (TEST FILTER)' is this project's own test_device_ids dev-scoping knob, not a camera problem -- shown separately in orange so it isn't read as a failure. The status cell uses 'color-background-solid' rather than the gradient-oriented 'color-background' mode -- the latter is tuned for numeric fields and does not reliably color a string/categorical field like this one. A camera whose identity could not be fully resolved (unknown_cctv_id / vision_node_not_found) is keyed by a sensor-based placeholder rather than its eventual company/cctv name, so its row's key -- and therefore its row -- changes once that sensor resolves; this is unavoidable without knowing the real identity ahead of time. Sorted by user_group_index -> vision_node_id -> camera to read as the user_groups -> vision_nodes -> CCTVs hierarchy defined in each site's overrides json file (static-method cameras have no user_group/vision_node, so they sort first with blank values). user_group_index/vision_node_id are string labels, so sort order is lexicographic, not numeric -- fine at this project's single-digit scale, worth revisiting if group/node counts grow past 9. Credentials and raw RTSP URIs are deliberately never in these metrics (see docs/prometheus_grafana_monitoring_plan.md §2). Click a camera to open its per-camera dashboard (reconnect rate, last-frame age, detection history, live snapshot).
